Score benchmark runs with a validated judge

Source: R/core-bench-judge.R
hr_scorer_judge.Rd

An hr_scorer() that grades each run's output against the item's label with a grade-mode judge. It is built only for a configuration that has a validation record hr_judge_valid() accepts; without one it refuses with an error of class hr_judge_unvalidated, since an unvalidated judge's decisions are not evidence of accuracy.

Usage

hr_scorer_judge(
  judge_config,
  validation,
  client,
  governor = NULL,
  draw_index = 0L
)

Arguments

judge_config

A grade-mode hr_judge_config().

validation

Its hr_judge_validate() record.

client

The gr_client the judge calls.

governor

Optional hr_governor() for the judge's requests.

draw_index

Draw index passed to every judge request (see gr_call()). With a caching client and a fixed index, identical outputs graded against the same label reuse one cached verdict; give another index for a fresh judge draw.

Value

An hr_scorer with two more elements: trace, the judge's gr_trace, and config_hash.

Details

Each output is graded in the configuration's orders with the label as the reference (several accepted answers are listed). A run is right when the judgement is answered with the configuration's positive grade. A run the judge left unresolved is wrong with outcome "judge_unresolved", and one it failed on is an "error" with outcome "judge_failed": counting them wrong keeps the arm's accuracy from rising on the items the judge could not settle. Outputs that report their own failure, or have no text, are sorted as hr_scorer_exact() sorts them, with no judge call.

The judge's requests are recorded in the scorer's own trace ($trace), held to governor, and never in the runs' traces, so a benchmark's cost columns leave judging out. Accuracy estimated by a judge should be reported corrected against human labels, with hr_judge_ppi().

See also

hr_judge_validate(), hr_benchmark(), hr_judge_ppi()

Other judges: hr_judge(), hr_judge_config(), hr_judge_ppi(), hr_judge_validate()

Examples

cfg <- hr_judge_config("mock-model", "Does the response give the reference's answer?",
                       mode = "grade")
try(hr_scorer_judge(cfg, NULL, gr_mock_client()))
#> Error in hr_scorer_judge(cfg, NULL, gr_mock_client()) : 
#>   This judge has no valid validation record: no validation record from hr_judge_validate(). Validate the configuration against blind human labels with hr_judge_validate() first.

set.seed(3)
human <- rep(c(TRUE, FALSE), c(60, 60))
v <- hr_judge_validate(cfg, data.frame(judge = ifelse(runif(120) < 0.9, human, !human),
                                       human = human), B = 200)
grader <- gr_mock_client(function(messages, params) {
  txt <- messages[[2]]$content
  ok <- grepl("Response to grade:\nParis", txt, fixed = TRUE)
  sprintf('{"verdict": "%s", "reason": "."}', if (ok) "pass" else "fail")
})
sc <- hr_scorer_judge(cfg, v, grader)
sc$fn("Capital of France?", "Paris", "Paris")$correct
#> [1] TRUE
sc$fn("Capital of France?", "Lyon", "Paris")$correct
#> [1] FALSE
